versions.changelog: Separate failed skill-detail fetches into a data_unavailable queue and exclude them from daily maintenance, cleanup, bulk, and AI candidate decisions.

Keep daily maintenance workflow plan-only, protect slug text from browser translation in the HTML dashboard, add chart fallback when matplotlib is unavailable, and move candidate-plan generation before dashboard rendering.
Simplify public display name from ClawHub Skill Maintainer to Skill Maintainer while keeping the stable slug and ClawHub portfolio workflow.
Add AI-assisted auto-upgrade planning with GitHub-first source fetching, ClawHub fallback commands, safe edit gates, and maintainer prompts.
Quality-first maintenance queues, data quality guardrails, and cleanup suppression for partial ClawHub data.
Initial public release with portfolio collection, snapshot baselines, growth dashboards, approval packets, and bulk cleanup planning.
